prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which NFL players were both league MVP and Super Bowl MVP in the same season?
answer:
As of August 1, 2024, **seven players** had won both the AP NFL regular-season MVP and Super Bowl MVP in the same season:

| Season | Player | Team | Super Bowl |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1966 | Bart Starr | Green Bay Packers | I |
| 1978 | Terry Bradshaw | Pittsburgh Steelers | XIII |
| 1989 | Joe Montana | San Francisco 49ers | XXIV |
| 1993 | Emmitt Smith | Dallas Cowboys | XXVIII |
| 1994 | Steve Young | San Francisco 49ers | XXIX |
| 1999 | Kurt Warner | St. Louis Rams | XXXIV |
| 2022 | Patrick Mahomes | Kansas City Chiefs | LVII |

Mahomes was the most recent player to accomplish it, doing so in the 2022 season (with Super Bowl LVII played in February 2023).
